value.title: Premise-bound Theorem-9/GK converse foundations
value.objective: Develop the full auxiliary-receiver Theorem-9 system into a rigorous private-message BSSC converse framework, separating premise authentication from conditional specialization, receiver reduction, and optimization of the resulting GK-type bound.
value.currentStateSummary: Conditional on the exact cited Theorem 9 outer-bound premise encoded in theorem9_spec.json, the private-message specialization has been expanded into an independently generated 30-row system. An exhaustive audit shows that every auxiliary-receiver term involves only one of G or K, so arbitrary finite auxiliary receivers may be replaced by their input-only product marginals without changing any row. This conditionally yields C_sum ≤ inf_{G,K} B(G,K) over finite-output binary-input receiver channels. The extended-real local definitions also give V_Q(G,K) ≤ V(1/2;G,K) ≤ B(G,K), while every Q_0-supported row depends on the receiver channels only through (c,g,k,c), making V_0(g,k) finite and well defined on its realizable domain. The cited theorem itself, its transcription, and its external provenance have not been authenticated by this result.
value.localResidualSummary: Independently authenticate or re-prove the cited outer-bound premise and its quantifier structure; then analyze receiver-cardinality reduction, attainment or compactness, continuity and boundary behavior, and the optimization of inf_{G,K} B(G,K) or V_0(g,k). Any numerical bound or capacity consequence beyond the accepted conditional inequality requires separate certification.

value.title: Conditional 30-row Theorem-9 specialization and product-marginal reduction
value.statement: Assume exactly the cited Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 outer-bound premise encoded in theorem9_spec.json: for each achievable rate triple there is one input prior that works for every finite auxiliary-receiver law, with an appropriate finite auxiliary hierarchy for each such law, under the encoded factorization, equations (19a)–(19p), and both side conditions. Conditional on that premise, setting R0=0, expanding every displayed minimum, and splitting the interval side conditions gives exactly the independently generated local 30-row private-message system. Every auxiliary-receiver information term in that system involves only G or only K, with no joint (G,K) term and no conditioning of one receiver output on another; consequently replacing G and K by their input-only product marginals preserves every row. Therefore, for the physical BSSC, C_sum ≤ inf B(G,K), where the infimum is over finite-output binary-input channels T_{G|X} and T_{K|X}. Under the submitted extended-real local definitions, including sup(empty set)=-infinity, V_Q(G,K) ≤ V(1/2;G,K) ≤ B(G,K). Moreover, every Q_0-supported row depends on the receiver channels only through (c,g,k,c), so V_0(g,k) is finite and well defined on the realizable (g,k)-domain.
scopeQualifications: Finiteness and well-definedness of V_0(g,k) hold only on the realizable (g,k)-domain.

The capacity conclusion is conditional on the premise's quantifier structure: one prior for each achievable rate pair works for every finite auxiliary-receiver law, with an appropriate finite hierarchy for each law.
The equality attestation establishes only syntactic and algebraic equality of the pinned encoded systems.
The product-marginal reduction relies on the audited system containing only single-output G or K information terms, with no joint (G,K) term and no conditioning of one receiver output on another.
The result does not authenticate the external theorem, manuscript, PDF, transcription provenance, rendering, or source fidelity.

proofs: Expanding the minima in the encoded equations after imposing R0=0 produces 26 scalar rows, and splitting the two interval side conditions produces four further nonnegative-slack rows.
An independently generated length-three path construction agrees row by row with the encoded 30-row specialization after only the stated mutual-information chain-rule normalizations.

The exhaustive output-term audit shows that all G- and K-bearing terms are single-output marginals. The factorization then preserves every relevant marginal when the auxiliary receiver is replaced by the product of its input-only G and K marginals.

Posterior mutual-information identities for Q_0-supported hierarchies reduce every row to the four midpoint channel values (c,g,k,c); explicit feasible zero rates and binary-output entropy bounds establish finiteness on the realizable domain.
methods: Exact symbolic expansion of minima and interval conditions
Independent path-row generation and algebraic normalization
computations: The submitted standard-library verifier checks the encoded factorization, all sixteen equation labels and two side conditions, generates all 30 private-message rows independently, compares their rate coefficients and signed information terms exactly, and audits the distinct output-bearing terms.
tools: The submitted Python standard-library checker performs an exact no-argument audit without floating-point arithmetic, external packages, network access, PDF parsing, or rendering.

value.title: Canonical problem
value.currentStateSummary: Three complementary converse directions are now established. First, genuine deterministic finite-block private-message codes induce approximate dependence balance, a fixed encoder-coordinate map, and four compatible rate rows, while an explicit nonbinary witness obstructs the specified coarse entropy and finite copy-lemma route; fixed-cardinality auxiliaries and exact BSSC posterior consistency remain unresolved. Second, the separately relaxed UV scalars tensorize: B_avg is additive for arbitrary finite-alphabet DMBC products, receiver-skew symmetry gives B_br=B_avg, and for the half-skew BSSC both product scalars equal n(2h_2(1/4)-5/4), without establishing capacity. Third, conditional on the exact encoded Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 premise and its stated quantifiers, the private-message specialization is exactly a 30-row system preserved by replacing arbitrary auxiliary receivers with input-only product marginals. This gives the conditional bound C_sum ≤ inf_{G,K} B(G,K), the inequalities V_Q(G,K) ≤ V(1/2;G,K) ≤ B(G,K), and a finite well-defined V_0(g,k) on its realizable domain. The external theorem and transcription provenance remain unauthenticated, and no numerical optimization of this new bound has been certified. The canonical capacity problem remains unresolved.
value.localResidualSummary: Authenticate or independently prove the full Theorem-9 premise and then obtain cardinality, compactness, continuity, or coercivity control sufficient to optimize its product-receiver bound. In parallel, derive exact binary-BSSC posterior and multiletter constraints for genuine code-induced laws, and retain coupling or nested auxiliary structure absent from the additive separately relaxed UV scalars. A resolution requires a certified numerical or analytic capacity improvement together with any matching achievability argument needed for equality.

placementAudit.rationale: The accepted claim establishes a reusable premise-bound full-Theorem-9/GK converse foundation rather than a refinement of the code-induced entropy program or the separately relaxed UV-scalar tensorization program. It therefore warrants its own durable child program under the canonical root. Its exact 30-row specialization, product-marginal reduction, conditional capacity inequality, and local-value consequences form one integrated independently reusable result because each consequence depends on the same audited system and explicit conditional premise.
